title: A massively parallel reporter assay reveals focused and broadly encoded RNA localization signals in neurons.
authors: Mikl, Martin; Eletto, Davide; Nijim, Malak; Lee, Minkyoung; Lafzi, Atefeh; Mhamedi, Farah; David, Orit; Sain, Simona Baghai; Handler, Kristina; Moor, Andreas E
one_liner_zh: 该文研究神经元中mRNA亚细胞定位信号，属于RNA定位机制，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合体系完全无关。
abstract: Asymmetric subcellular mRNA localization allows spatial regulation of gene expression and functional compartmentalization. In neurons, localization of specific mRNAs to neurites is essential for cellular functioning. However, it is largely unknown how transcript sorting works in a sequence-specific manner. Here, we combined subcellular transcriptomics and massively parallel reporter assays and tested  approximately 50 000 sequences for their ability to localize to neurites. Mapping the localization potential of >300 genes revealed two ways neurite targeting can be achieved: focused localization motifs and broadly encoded localization potential. We characterized the interplay between RNA stability and localization and identified motifs able to bias localization towards neurite or soma as well as the trans-acting factors required for their action. Based on our data, we devised machine learning models that were able to predict the localization behavior of novel reporter sequences. Testing this predictor on native mRNA sequencing data showed good agreement between predicted and observed localization potential, suggesting that the rules uncovered by our MPRA also apply to the localization of native full-length transcripts.
abstract_zh: 不对称的亚细胞mRNA定位允许基因表达的空间调控和功能分区。在神经元中，特定mRNA向神经突的定位对细胞功能至关重要。然而，转录本如何以序列特异性的方式进行分选在很大程度上仍是未知的。在此，我们结合了亚细胞转录组学和大规模平行报告基因分析，测试了约50,000个序列定位到神经突的能力。对超过300个基因的定位潜力进行作图，揭示了神经突靶向可通过两种方式实现：聚焦定位基序和广泛编码的定位潜力。我们表征了RNA稳定性与定位之间的相互作用，并鉴定了能够将定位偏向神经突或胞体的基序，以及其作用所需的反式作用因子。基于我们的数据，我们设计了机器学习模型，能够预测新型报告序列的定位行为。将该预测器应用于天然mRNA测序数据，显示预测与观察到的定位潜力之间具有良好一致性，表明我们的MPRA所揭示的规则也适用于天然全长转录本的定位。
